title: Camps — a partial refund: how does the admin hand back the rest?
subtitle: The case picture 22 didn't cover: a refund of only part of what was overpaid. Real preview screens of the built Record refund (April Vacation Camp, the preview set to Wed, Apr 21, 2027): Emma Garcia paid $315 by card; Friday was taken off, so she paid $23 more than the total; an admin recorded a $10 cash refund. She is still $13 overpaid and the hint still says “⋯ → Record refund”, but the ⋯ and More show Undo refund in Record refund's place (the approved rule v0.743 (4)). Amber = what differs from the built screens.

columns.label: A · both items while still overpaid (recommended)

row.caption: PC, Camper detail (as built): still “Paid $13 more than the total”; the hint “… ⋯ → Record refund.” stays and is true.
⋯: Record refund, then Undo refund, after Undo payment; Edit payment and Undo payment stay gray.

columns.note: The admin records the other $13 directly. Undo refund undoes the newest refund. The database already allows a second refund up to what is still overpaid; only the menu changes.

columns.label: B · keep the approved menu, change the hint

row.caption: PC, Camper detail: while a refund stands and money is still overpaid, the hint reads “To hand back more, an admin first uses ⋯ → Undo refund, then records the whole amount.”

columns.note: Two steps and two Finance lines for one hand-back.

footer:
How it was drawn: mock-x8-partial-refund.js adds only what differs: in A a Record refund item cloned from the real Undo refund item (ti-receipt-refund icon), in B the hint's words; everything else is the built screen.

Recommendation: A — one step for the desk, and the hint stays true. Your choice: A or B?
